title: RWB-S6-E6008-APP: the derecognition and posting slice has no plan row for its four consumed contracts and its interface call, no posting column, no published operation names and no requirement id
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6008-APP; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-008; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.12, A1.3, A1.4 and Requirements served; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.0 to T3.3, T4, T5.1, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-29 to R-DS-33; Event and Messaging Design v4 rows EV-23 and EV-25; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-12
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S6-E6008-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-source-data account and balance facts, the rwb-case state, the rwb-decision package and the rwb-integration posting interface, so one interface call and four consumed surfaces have no plan row. (2) No column of debt_sale_lot or debt_sale_account carries the posting result, the item reference or the rejection reason in TSD S6 T3.1 or in the legacy Data table, so the record and the case state carry the result and the story adds no column. (3) The operation names of the account read, the case-move answer, the package read and the interface activity, and the interface identifier, transport, layout, result codes and retry schedule, are published by no source in the read set. (4) TSD S6 T6.1 gives RW-CREDITAD the Debt sale right R only, while R-DS-31 and R-DS-33 name Credit Administration in their owner column as the actor of the posting and the re-post. (5) R-DS-31 carries the month-end close in its timer column while the service owns no job row and no Schedule is declared anywhere for the step. (6) The legacy Data table names interaction and decision_log_entry, which this service may neither read nor write, and its endpoint rows carry the monolith base /api/recovery/v1 and are API-S6-001 and API-S6-002, owned by the lot builder and the data room. (7) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice. (8) The message text of a rejected posting is rwb-integration's row and no source gives it.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S6-E6008-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-03, DP-05, DP-13 and DP-19 rows and R5.7 Day-1 rule; context pack ownership rows (debt_sale_lot and debt_sale_account, S6; 5 REST operations; event EV-23; workflow DebtSaleWorkflow; jobs 0) and connection-matrix row S6 (Temporal to P7, P5, P8 and P2, events from P8); TSD S6 T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1 INT-25, T6.1 and T-A.1; FSD S6 A2.12.1 to A2.12.3.3; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-29 to R-DS-33; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-23 and EV-25; legacy RWB-E6-008 Data, Endpoints, Screen and states, Validation and messages, Acceptance criteria and Guardrails
area: Dependency, data, operation naming and requirement trace
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand and record the four reads and the interface call as class C in fact with their placeholders; carry the posting result, the item reference and the rejection code in the decision record and the case state and add no column, so the DB story keeps the schema; run the posting and the re-post under the service identity and let RW-CREDITAD read and work the R-DS-32 exception task; hold the month-end close as a durable timer of DebtSaleWorkflow and declare no Schedule; adopt REQ-S6-008 for traceability; take the message text of a rejected posting from rwb-integration's exception queue row

title: RWB-S6-E6008-CON: the contract baseline declares no operation and no answer property because TSD S6 T-A publishes no derecognition or posting surface and no column carries the result, and the four operation names and the interface values are unpublished
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6008-CON; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale; legacy RWB-E6-008; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.12.2 and A2.12.3; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-29 to R-DS-33; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-23 and EV-25
section: Metadata (Dependencies); Sections 2, 7 AC1 to AC7, 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.5, 12.6, 12.8, 12.9 and 18
description: (1) TSD S6 appendix T-A publishes five operations and none of them is a derecognition, a posting or a posting-result operation, so the baseline declares no provided operation and the two legacy endpoint rows are API-S6-001 and API-S6-002, owned by the lot builder and the data room. (2) No column of debt_sale_lot or debt_sale_account carries the posting result, the item reference or the rejection reason, so no published answer can carry the elements and they are declared as activity and record elements only. (3) The operation names of the account read, the case-move answer, the package read and the interface activity are published by no source, and the interface identifier, transport, layout, result codes and retry schedule are rwb-integration's configuration rows with no value in the read set. (4) No source enumerates the item types of a derecognition posting, so the three item-type names are baseline names derived from R-DS-31's systems column. (5) The message text of a rejected posting is rwb-integration's row and no source gives it. (6) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice, and the plan's C, I and X rows are empty while the baseline declares five consumed rows.
evidence: TSD S6 T-A.1 operations API-S6-001 to API-S6-005 and T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids; TSD S6 T3.1 field list with no posting column; TSD S6 T3.2 lists LOV-LOT-STATUS, LOV-SEGMENT, LOV-BUYER-CLASS and LOV-PUTBACK; TSD S6 T4 DEBTSALE machine; context pack connection-matrix row S6 (Temporal to P7, P5, P8 and P2) and service row (topic rwb.debtsale.events.v1, queue rwb-debtsale, event EV-23, jobs 0); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-29 to R-DS-33; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-23 and EV-25; FSD S6 A2.12.2 (integration points ALS and GL) and A2.12.3.1 (VR-S6-012-1, R-DS-31, R-DS-33, BR-S6-012); legacy RWB-E6-008 Endpoints, Data and Validation and messages
area: Contract surface, interface names and data
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders and the two absence records, confirm the four operation names and the interface values with their owners before the tag, keep the item-type names as baseline names until rwb-integration's interface row is published, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, and record the tag date in the contract README
